likely_prediction_error: A persistence or recovery path still sends an oversized object or fails to reconstruct the exact historical/pending State, preventing actual acceptance or restart recovery.
rejection_rule: Missing all-five acceptance; differing roots; missing pending/final restart; incomplete pending upload; loss of historical-state semantics; changed RPC/block/transaction limits or proof parameters; treating communication errors as semantic rejection; or mutation of existing deployments blocks acceptance.
promotion_rule: At most smoke_only; no security certification, independent operators, full application migration or production promotion. The separate v2 owner-agreement work is not part of these frozen v1 proofs.
